SELECT p.production_type_code, AVG(p.unit_price) AS average_unit_price, AVG(p.unit_price) - overall.average_group_average AS difference_from_overall
FROM Products AS p
JOIN (
  SELECT AVG(group_average) AS average_group_average
  FROM (
    SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS group_average
    FROM Products
    GROUP BY production_type_code
  )
  WHERE group_average IS NOT NULL
) AS overall
WHERE p.production_type_code IN (
  SELECT production_type_code FROM Products GROUP BY production_type_code
)
GROUP BY p.production_type_code
HAVING AVG(p.unit_price) > overall.average_group_average
ORDER BY difference_from_overall DESC
LIMIT 10
